descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S18 From Nursing Home: Settings shows the account, privacy, delete, support and version rows; Sign out lands on the sign-in screen and the lists stay gated

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T5 Sign out ends the session. The physician must sign in again with an email code. (TFA-94700 AC 2)
  • T11 Settings shows the signed-in physician's email, Sign out, Privacy Policy, Delete account, a Support contact and the app version, the same way in Hospital and in Nursing Home. … (TFA-94700 AC 1; TFA-94700 AC 3; TFA-94700 AC 7)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given The lane C fixture (signed in, consented)

When The agent switches to Nursing Home, opens Settings, presses Sign out, then opens /snf and /rounding

Then Settings, opened from the Nursing Home list, shows who is signed in, Sign out, Sign out everywhere, Delete account, Privacy Policy, Contact support and the version. After Sign out, the sign-in screen shows the Email field and Send sign-in code, and neither test patient. Both lists still show the sign-in screen and neither test patient.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs mustContain / mustNotContain per checkpoint: T11 (TFA-94700 AC 1 and 7: the Settings rows in Nursing Home) on cp1, T5 (AC 2: the session is ended and a sign-in is needed again) on cp2-cp4. Both are ungated TFA-94700 requirements, so a failure reports as Fail. The sign-in screen's copy (T1) is S16 cp1; link targets are S20 and S23.

Where it ran: local lane C (browser agent cases); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane C.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane C).

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S18

From Nursing Home: Settings shows the account, privacy, delete, support and version rows; Sign out lands on the sign-in screen and the lists stay gated

Tickets: TFA-94700 Physician Settings & AI Consent (store requirements) (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (generated/oat01s18/verdict.json). Agent: 24 turns, 49 s, $0.14.

Plan said: local-only — this run has a result anyway, so the result is shown.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The goal presses Sign out, which is always refused on dev because it ends the saved sign-in every dev run uses (runner-contract §10.4), and then checks the signed-out lists.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
